name: D3
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Data-driven scales, layouts and shapes; use its geometry, not its transitions
summary: Modular JavaScript library for binding data to DOM or SVG and computing layouts, scales, shapes, paths, colour interpolation and transitions. In VCR use its pure functions (d3-scale, d3-shape, d3-hierarchy, d3-force) to compute geometry, draw with SVG and animate with GSAP; avoid its built-in transitions, which run on a wall clock. Output is SVG or canvas drawing in a browser scene.
use_when: Charts and layouts (treemap, force, chord, geo) computed from data and drawn as SVG
Over chart-template libraries when you need bespoke marks and full control of geometry
Using d3-scale or d3-shape alone as maths helpers inside canvas, p5.js or Three.js scenes
avoid_when: A standard bar or line chart on a deadline: author SVG directly
Motion must be seekable: d3 transitions use a real-time clock, so drive frames from GSAP
Static diagram from text: Graphviz or Mermaid CLI lay out faster
notes: 2026-10-26: whether recent d3/d3 commits are substantive was not checked; maintenance rated by release date.

assessment.rationale: Last npm release 7.9.0 on 2024-03-12 (about 31 months); repository pushed 2026-10-21, so maintained but release cadence is slow. ISC licence. Mature and stable; value for data-driven geometry is clear.
